description:
Route every CLI test that plants, reads or corrupts lease storage through one shared test helper, so the lease store layout is spelled once in the test tree.

## Background

CLI tests reach the claims index directly:

- `tests/cli_item_validate/validation_lease_tests.rs:112-125` (`write_claims_index`, used by the `validate --leases` tests) and `:180-190` (a malformed index);
- `tests/cli_repo_workflow/claim_integration_tests.rs:177` (reads a lease from the index) and `:302-304` (removes the index's permissions);
- `tests/cli_issue/failure_probe_fixture.rs:636-640` (`malformed-claim-index` writes invalid JSON over the index);
- `tests/cli_issue/command_exit_code_projection_tests.rs:755-760` (corrupts the index).

Shared test code lives in `tests/common/` and is included per suite through `#[path]` (`tests/fast_issue/main.rs:6`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One helper module under `crates/jit/tests/common/` plants a lease, reads a lease, names an issue's lease storage path and corrupts lease storage, and the listed tests use it; no CLI test names `claims.index.json` outside the helper.
- [hard] REQ-02: The listed tests pass unchanged in what they assert.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: CLI tests reach lease storage through one test helper
